title: Measurement-Process Perturbation Invariance Audit
bootstrap_revision_evidence_conflict: The bootstrap predates approved operational and experimental commits; repository HEAD remains canonical.
scientific_question: What observational properties remain invariant, and which cease to remain invariant, under controlled perturbations of the measurement process?
evidence_unavailable_before_experiment: The repository did not contain independently detected evidence under a declared perturbation that changes detector/grid phase while preserving exact source-sample lineage.
selected_perturbation: 256-sample audio-origin shift relative to the fixed 512-sample observation grid
selection_reason: It changes one declared measurement condition, preserves all nonzero samples and their ordering, exercises independent detection, and adds less complexity than resampling, noise or compression.

analysis_configuration.recurrence_definition: exact consecutive positive frame interval occurring at least twice
